## README.md
# Gridded global GDP per capita (PPP), 1990-2024

![GDP](https://img.shields.io/badge/GDP-blue) ![GDP per capita](https://img.shields.io/badge/GDP_per_capita-blue) ![purchasing power parity](https://img.shields.io/badge/purchasing_power_parity-blue) ![economy](https://img.shields.io/badge/economy-blue) ![downscaling](https://img.shields.io/badge/downscaling-blue) ![subnational](https://img.shields.io/badge/subnational-blue) ![admin 2](https://img.shields.io/badge/admin_2-blue)

A Portolan mirror of the downscaled global GDP per capita (PPP) dataset by Kummu, Kosonen, and Masoumzadeh Sayyar at Aalto University ([Zenodo record 18429133](https://zenodo.org/records/18429133)). It gives annual GDP per capita in 2021 international dollars for 1990 to 2024 at the national, reported-subnational, and downscaled admin 2 levels, as polygons and 5 arc-minute grids. It also has total GDP grids at 30 arc-second, 5 arc-minute, and 30 arc-minute resolution, and uncertainty grids for the admin 2 product. The method is described in [Kummu et al. 2025](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41597-025-04487-x). Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before you query the data.

## Processing Notes

Downloaded from Zenodo record 18429133 (published 2026-03-13, the latest version on 2026-11-20). All 17 files were checked against the Zenodo MD5 sums. GeoPackages were converted to GeoParquet with gpio (Hilbert order, ZSTD). The 41 invalid adm1 polygons and 72 invalid adm2 polygons were repaired with ST_MakeValid, and line slivers from the repair were dropped so every row is a MultiPolygon. The all-null `id` column of the adm2 file was dropped, and `GID_nmbr` and `adm2ID` were cast from float to integer. GeoTIFFs were converted to COGs with portolan-cli (DEFLATE, floating-point predictor, average-resampled overviews, exact per-band statistics). The pixel values and grids were not changed. PMTiles were built with tylertoo 0.8.0. The meaning of `slope` comes from the authors' code ([f_gdp_data2gpkg_adm2.R](https://github.com/mattikummu/griddedGDPpc/blob/main/functions/f_gdp_data2gpkg_adm2.R)). The tabulated CSV files repeat the GeoPackage attributes without geometry and are not mirrored. code_input_data.zip (1.2 GB of model inputs) is linked at Zenodo and not mirrored.
